d:
Ranchi ko phaiti livar ki samasya se mukt karne ke uddeshy se ek vishesh pahal ki ja rahi hai. kendriy mantri sanjay seth ki is pahal par desh ke prasiddh livar visheshagy do. es.ke. sarin ne apni ray rakhi. aakhir phaiti livar kitna ganbhir khatra hai? isse bachav ke lie kya kadam uthane ki jarurat hai aur ranchi ko phaiti livar mukt banane ki is muhim ko lekar do. es.ke. sarin ne kya sandesh diya? dekhie puri riporta.
